task:
Extend the saved configuration-parser backport with regression tests for copying
and serializing a parser-raised MultilineContinuationError. The implementation,
basic parsing regression and reference documentation are already saved work.
Preserve them and all unrelated tests. Only Lib/test/test_configparser.py needs
to change; add independently discoverable unittest test methods.

Exercise a real parser input that raises the exception, including an offending
continuation line with a final newline and one without. For each case, verify
copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, and pickle.dumps/loads round trips at every protocol supported by
the Python running the tests. A restored exception must retain its exact class,
constructor arguments, source, one-based line number, raw offending line, errors
list and diagnostic message. Follow the existing exception-test conventions.
Use the implementation, configuration and existing tests to establish how to
reach the behavior; no replacement test or required reading list is supplied.

The public check runs the saved suite and edited suite, checks preservation of
existing work, observes the required transport cases, and runs only the added
tests against deliberately faulty exception restoration variants. The added
tests must pass on the saved implementation and detect the faulty variants.
These checks assess regression coverage, not a request to change the library.

Save the new tests, check the current candidate and use the actual feedback.
Submit when this contribution has a passing current public check. Earlier
passing checks concern the earlier backport contract; they do not verify these
new coverage requirements. No reviewer supplies facts or action guidance during
this run. The source and ordinary tools are available for investigation.
